retrievalProfile.description: A dense, multi-character cartoon illustration featuring mod-style figures dancing in a psychedelic environment with heavy black outlines and flat, vibrant colors.
triggerTerms: flat color ink drawing with heavy outlines

recipe.visualDefinition: A crowded, energetic scene of stylized cartoon characters in 1960s fashion, set against a yellow background with radiating pink sunburst lines. The style uses thick black ink outlines, flat color fills, and a top-heavy typographic header.
coreVisualRelationships: Dense character cluster in the lower two-thirds
Radiating sunburst lines originating from a central gumball machine
Large, outlined display type spanning the top black header
Repetitive circular and geometric icons scattered throughout the scene
coreInvariants: Heavy black ink outlines on all figures and objects
1960s mod fashion including go-go boots, striped shirts, and mini-skirts

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A band on a small stage occupies the center-midground, surrounded by smaller dancing figures in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A central gumball machine acts as the focal point for the radiating background lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top text, moves down the radiating lines to the central band, and then circulates through the dancing figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is 'horror vacui' style, filled with characters and icons.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant pink, blue, and green for clothing and sunbursts
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with high value contrast between the yellow field and black outlines.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to primary and secondary brights

characterSpecificRedesigns: Tightly kerned characters that occasionally touch
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy display face paired with small, blocky sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and blunt terminals.
Provides the geometric slab feel common in 60s display type.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1960s mod cartoon illustration on a bright yellow background. Include a central gumball machine with pink sunburst lines radiating from it. Fill the scene with diverse characters in mod fashion (boots, mini-skirts, suits) dancing. Use thick black ink outlines and flat colors. Leave a solid black rectangular bar at the top for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, uppercase slab-serif text centered in the top black bar. The text should have a blue fill with a white inner outline and a black outer outline.

verificationChecks: Are the outlines thick and black?
Is the background primarily bright yellow?
Is the text double-outlined and slab-serif?
Are the characters in 1960s mod attire?

adjustableVariables: Specific icons in the background circles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is garbled or nonsensical
Check that the black header bar is distinct from the illustration
Verify that the sunburst lines originate from a central point
Confirm all characters have consistent black outlines
